messages:
mike_h: Quick perf readout from the MQA/GQA + paged-KV layout batch run. Wanted to capture details before we drift.
sophia_l: nice, drop the numbers pls.

mike_h: runs on Hopper x2 80GB
- model: gqa-32b-mqa (2x heads per token)
- batch: 8 concurrent requests, token distribution skewed (mostly 512/1024, some 2048)
- paged-KV config: block_size candidates = [32, 64, 128]
- KV layout: contiguous-shard vs interleaved-block

mike_h: results (avg tokens/sec, lower is worse):
- block 32 / contiguous: 12.3k tok/s
- block 64 / contiguous: 15.1k tok/s
- block 128 / contiguous: 14.9k tok/s
- block 64 / interleaved: 16.4k tok/s (best)

jana_p: interesting that interleaved wins. did you try different seq mixes?

mike_h: yes. With heavy 2048 proportion (30%): interleaved+64 keeps steady, contiguous drops ~18% at 2048 peaks.

rao_k: hypothesis: interleaved reduces strided memory accesses for KV read at high seqlen with MQA packing. Also better L2 utilization on Hopper.

sophia_l: any kernel selection logic triggered? which kernel was chosen for attention (paged vs fused)?

mike_h: autotuner picked paged-attn for <1024 mostly, but for mixed >1500 it fell back to generic-gqa-kernel which is slower. Selector thresholds currently: if seq_mean < 800 -> paged; else generic. Seems naive.

mike_h: perf-bot also flagged a regression on the generic-gqa-kernel change from last release (latency p90 +12%).

perf-bot: CI perf alert: eng-runtime/gqa-kernel[generic] increased p90 by 12% vs baseline at 1839800000. See: https://ci.internal/perf/1839800000

jana_p: suggests we make selector aware of seqlen distribution (percentile) and kvcache layout. e.g. if p95_seq > 1200 AND layout==interleaved -> prefer interleaved-optimized-kernel.

sophia_l: agreed. Also add architecture hint (ampere vs hopper) because we saw different kernel asymptotics. On Ampere the contiguous 64 slightly wins.

rao_k: propose small heuristic patch:
```
// pseudocode selector
if (arch == HOPPER) {
  if (kvcache.layout == INTERLEAVED) {
    if (seq_p95 > 1200) pick(kernels.interleaved_64);
    else if (seq_mean < 800) pick(kernels.paged_fast);
    else pick(kernels.interleaved_fallback);
  } else { // contiguous
    if (seq_mean < 700) pick(kernels.paged_fast);
    else pick(kernels.contig_64);
  }
} else { // AMPERE or others
  // prefer contig for many workloads
}
```

mike_h: plan: implement selector change + add microbenchmark harness that sweeps block_size + layout + seq mix. I'll run harness in perf tier tomorrow AM.

jana_p: can we also add a quick binary switch in rollout config to force interleaved_64 so customers can validate? feature flag + rollout.

sophia_l: yes. add telemetry tag: kernel_choice + block_size + layout so we can correlate.

mike_h: will do. leaving action items:
- mike_h: implement selector + harness (tomorrow)
- jana_p: flag + rollout config (this week)
- rao_k: review kernel micro-impl for mem-alignment (PR 1227)
- sophia_l: add telemetry + dashboard card

mike_h: noted. re-running long sweep now, will post summary when done. :eyes:
